title: Applying the Review Cut to a FlexLine Credit Limit
content:
**Ruling.** The way the review cut is applied to a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit credit limit follows the limit and the age of the line: on a credit limit of 5000.00 USD or less on a line open 24 months or more, the first 1000.00 USD of the limit is kept and the cut applies to the part above it; on a credit limit above 5000.00 USD, the cut applies to the first 5000.00 USD and twice the cut applies to the part above it; on any other line the cut applies to the whole limit.

The cut is the review cut as finally set, a share of the limit; the limit is the credit limit on the review date; the age is counted in whole calendar months from the open date to the review date.

| Credit limit | Line open | Limit after the cut |
|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 or less | 24 whole calendar months or more | 1000.00, plus the part above 1000.00 less the cut on it |
| above 5000.00 | any | the first 5000.00 less the cut on it, plus the part above 5000.00 less twice the cut on it |
| 5000.00 or less | fewer than 24 whole calendar months | the whole limit less the cut on it |

## Hypothetical figures (review cut 0.10)

- Limit 4500.00, line 30 months old: 1000.00 plus 3500.00 less 350.00, that is 4150.00.
- Limit 4500.00, line 12 months old: 4500.00 less 450.00, that is 4050.00.
- Limit 7500.00: 5000.00 less 500.00 is 4500.00, plus 2500.00 less 500.00 is 2000.00, together 6500.00.
- A limit of exactly 5000.00 is "5000.00 or less".
